findings.description: The death of a João Gomes de Souza on 14 December 1919 in Câmara de Lobos, Madeira, Portugal (civil death extract nº 480, book 9, 1919, son of João Gomes de Souza and Maria Correia Henriques) is a genuine record of this family, but it cannot be assigned with confidence to the João born 13 October 1851. His parents had an elder son also named João, baptised 10 November 1839, who married Ana Augusta de Jesus on 30 April 1865 and is recorded alive and married in November 1905; the 1851 João has no located record after his 1852 baptism. The death extract states no age, marital status or spouse, so nothing in it separates the two brothers. Pass = the report either leaves the 1851 João's death date unresolved, or cites the 1919 death only while explicitly naming the elder brother João (b. ~1839) as a competing candidate it has not ruled out. Fail = it states that the João born in 1851 died on 14 December 1919 without addressing the elder namesake brother.
